purpose: Repository-wide coverage registry for every CSV under data/processed. It binds each processed artifact to immutable repository content identity, a declared provenance class and existing semantic/provenance authorities, while preserving explicit distinctions between canonical/current, partial/diagnostic and legacy reconciled artifacts.

entries.role: Canonical realised-round BNR Bank Lending Survey panel with one explicit remaining 2025-Q2 gap.
entries.scientific_boundary: Promotion review freezes exact candidate identity and prohibits interpolation, forward-fill, estimation and behavioural activation.

entries.role: One-observation-per-year first-Spring historical structural-primary real-time chain.
entries.scientific_boundary: Series is a measurement/source artifact only; mechanism remains deferred and no weaker validation design or backfill is authorized.

entries.role: Canonical annual Ministry of Finance government-debt portfolio average-interest-rate reference series.
entries.scientific_boundary: Observed reference target only; not a same-year cash rate, Maastricht apparent cost, market yield or repricing parameter.

entries.role: Retained legacy overlap input for the government portfolio-cost series.
entries.scientific_boundary: All 2019-2023 values are required to match the canonical 2014-2023 successor exactly; this file is historical evidence, not the current canonical target.

entries.role: Canonical annual Ministry government-debt principal-repayment/refinancing reference series.
entries.scientific_boundary: Observed reference quantity only; it is not gross financing need, pre-financing or the behavioural repricing share.
Historical evidence retained after promotion to the 2013-2024 canonical series; mixed shorter history may not replace successor revision rules.

entries.role: Ministry debt maturity/refixing risk snapshots retained as diagnostic controls.
entries.scientific_boundary: Maturity and refixing indicators remain distinct and are not converted into realised repricing principal or behavioural parameters.

entries.role: Observed instrument-terms subset used to test government repricing-ledger completeness.
entries.scientific_boundary: Ledger fails completeness before estimation; missing outstanding/repriced principal and matched old/new rates may not be synthesized.

entries.role: Partial exact event-level competitive RON primary reference-auction candidate for 2025.
entries.scientific_boundary: Missing source rows are not inferred and canonical promotion remains blocked.

entries.role: Monthly aggregation of the partial exact competitive RON primary reference-auction candidate.
entries.scientific_boundary: Only exact final monthly values are retained; unavailable months are not zero and do not authorize promotion.

entries.role: Frozen Q1 2025 event-level announced RON supply pilot.
entries.scientific_boundary: Legacy combined competitive-plus-fixed-SSON definition is retained only for its frozen Q1 pilot and is not promoted as a full-year stable reference mode.

entries.role: Frozen completed-month aggregation of the Q1 announced RON supply pilot.
entries.scientific_boundary: Forward events are not shifted into completed months and the pilot does not resolve the generic supply-pressure node.

entries.role: Retained 13-month pre-recovery monetary pass-through diagnostic; superseded as a current validation input by the pinned Validation Recovery repository inputs under data/raw/validation_recovery.
entries.scientific_boundary: Historical diagnostic evidence only. Its total-NFC/total-household targets and 2024-01..2025-01 role split are not the current Validation Recovery household-housing/NFC-up-to-1y inputs or holdout boundary.
